The name Maryelle combines the virtues of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is revered in Christian tradition for her piety, obedience, and devotion to God. In biblical context, Mary is the mother of Jesus and the epitome of feminine virtues, including humility, compassion, and selflessness.
